meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Shattered Mirror
meta.description: Pull the night aside, and let light shine through.

units.rawText: The sacrifice I imagined was merely a sort of simulation of the past. Perhaps in the future, that is the path I will take to save someone I absolutely did not wish to lose.
units.displayText: The sacrifice I imagined was merely a sort of simulation of the past. Perhaps in the future, that is the path I will take to save someone I absolutely did not wish to lose.

spans.text: The sacrifice I imagined was merely a sort of simulation of the past. Perhaps in the future, that is the path I will take to save someone I absolutely did not wish to lose.

units.rawText: But now the path back lays in front of you, and you choose sacrifice. What a fallacy.
units.displayText: But now the path back lays in front of you, and you choose sacrifice. What a fallacy.

spans.text: But now the path back lays in front of you, and you choose sacrifice. What a fallacy.

units.rawText: No other paths exist. I've found Knot again, and I've protected everyone...
units.displayText: No other paths exist. I've found Knot again, and I've protected everyone...

spans.text: No other paths exist. I've found Knot again, and I've protected everyone...

units.rawText: Given up on the third person perspective game now? Playing around with puppeting my shadow, how truly repulsive.
units.displayText: Given up on the third person perspective game now? Playing around with puppeting my shadow, how truly repulsive.

spans.text: Given up on the third person perspective game now? Playing around with puppeting my shadow, how truly repulsive.

units.rawText: Look outside, Lind. Ruins, miles around.
units.displayText: Look outside, Lind. Ruins, miles around.

spans.text: Look outside, Lind. Ruins, miles around.

units.rawText: ...Did you only come here to hurt me?
units.displayText: ...Did you only come here to hurt me?

spans.text: ...Did you only come here to hurt me?

units.rawText: It's fine, I'm used to the pain...
units.displayText: It's fine, I'm used to the pain...

spans.text: It's fine, I'm used to the pain...

units.rawText: No. I am simply here to tell you that your presumed sacrifice is nothing of consequence.
units.displayText: No. I am simply here to tell you that your presumed sacrifice is nothing of consequence.

spans.text: No. I am simply here to tell you that your presumed sacrifice is nothing of consequence.

units.rawText: You refused to face reality. You use yourself as payment, a cost in some sort of exchange for a perfect result.
units.displayText: You refused to face reality. You use yourself as payment, a cost in some sort of exchange for a perfect result.

spans.text: You refused to face reality. You use yourself as payment, a cost in some sort of exchange for a perfect result.

units.rawText: ...Is that so wrong? If I give myself up, I can exchange it for a perfect result.
units.displayText: ...Is that so wrong? If I give myself up, I can exchange it for a perfect result.

spans.text: ...Is that so wrong? If I give myself up, I can exchange it for a perfect result.

units.rawText: Knot would never have had to die covering someone else's tracks, and Persicaria could continue in her aspirations...
units.displayText: Knot would never have had to die covering someone else's tracks, and Persicaria could continue in her aspirations...

spans.text: Knot would never have had to die covering someone else's tracks, and Persicaria could continue in her aspirations...

units.rawText: —"I could not attain strength, so I chose to sacrifice myself, so I would not have to face the world."
units.displayText: —"I could not attain strength, so I chose to sacrifice myself, so I would not have to face the world."

spans.text: —"I could not attain strength, so I chose to sacrifice myself, so I would not have to face the world."

units.rawText: To lack the courage to face reality, to lack the gall to find a true solution to the problem. This is not a noble sacrifice; it is simply suicide.
units.displayText: To lack the courage to face reality, to lack the gall to find a true solution to the problem. This is not a noble sacrifice; it is simply suicide.

spans.text: To lack the courage to face reality, to lack the gall to find a true solution to the problem. This is not a noble sacrifice; it is simply suicide.
